bibliography.checked_against: Crossref and the article's first page
bibliography.note: Borowiak, D., Bociąg, K., Nowiński, K. & Borowiak, M. 2017. Light requirements of water lobelia (Lobelia dortmanna L.). Limnological Review 17(4): 171–182, doi:10.1515/limre-2017-0016. The entry agrees. Crossref now lists the publisher as MDPI AG.

claims.claim: water lobelia was studied in 25 Polish soft-water lakes
claims.quote: studied in 25 soft water lobelia lakes in north-western Poland
claims.conditions: Pomeranian lakes; light measured twice a year (mid-spring, mid-summer) in 2014–2015

claims.claim: water lobelia reached a median of only 0.8 m (range 0.1–2.2 m)
claims.location: p. 171 (PDF p. 1), Abstract; p. 175 (PDF p. 5), Results and Table 2
claims.quote: ranged from 0.1 to 2.2 m (median zC = 0.8 m
claims.conditions: zC = maximum depth of colonization of each lake's lobelia population; mean zC 1.0 m; 0.1 m in Lake Czarne by Borzytuchom, 2.2 m in Ostronek and Rekowskie

claims.claim: the maximum depth is about SD/3
claims.location: p. 171 (PDF p. 1), Abstract; p. 180 (PDF p. 10), Discussion
claims.quote: accounts for approximately a third of the Secchi disc depth
claims.conditions: a ratio of means across the lakes: mean zC 1 m against mean Secchi depth 2.8 m (and one fifth of the mean euphotic depth, 5 m); not a per-lake rule

claims.location: p. 171 (PDF p. 1), Abstract; p. 179 (PDF p. 9), Discussion
claims.quote: irradiance of PAR at zC equal to about 43% of subsurface irradiance
claims.conditions: relative PAR at zC: mean 43.2 %, median 43.8 % across the 25 lakes; individual lakes ranged 10.2–87.7 %
claims.note: The authors stress the wide between-lake range and prefer a minimum light exposure to a single species limit.
